description: Seller: update an order's tracking and move it forward: awaiting → shipped, then shipped → delivered (delivery releases payment to you). Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

tracking_update.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

name: geode_market_update_order_tracking_information
title: Market: update order tracking information
